purpose: Make the existing v2 human-first comparison preparation executable without changing the shared command architecture or installing a candidate.
hypothesis_for_future_matched_comparison: QA-eligible supplied synthetic training improves human accepted complete-command recall at fixed architecture, optimizer/update budget and gates; missing human coverage must be addressed first.

rules.catalog: Preserve the complete existing 1031-entry release catalog and all 415 approved benchmark/superset definitions; no test-derived additions or invented defaults.
rules.human_gate: All 18 command intents plus true UNKNOWN required in human train, dev and calibration before features or fitting; class presence alone is not acoustic qualification or statistically sufficient sample size.
rules.synthetic: Separately labelled training view only; no synthetic in human train/dev/calibration; original mixed-origin published test/holdout retained byte for byte.
rules.leakage: Reject duplicate IDs/files/PCM and declared cross-split speaker/pair identities; do not claim to resolve acoustic aliases or near duplicates.
rules.normalization: Equal weight per eligible human training utterance with unchanged vcm.frontend; dev/synthetic/calibration/evaluation excluded from normalization.
rules.features: Only human/train, human/dev and synthetic/train; verify original file and decoded PCM hashes; record feature file hashes before any fitting.
rules.failed_gate: Write readiness.json then exit 2 before feature extraction; no preparation.json is issued.
rules.claims: Metadata/software evidence only. Existing test is historical. Fresh human holdout, wake ownership, overlap handling and Pi measurements remain open.
